visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a young man and woman sitting closely together, both wearing sparkling green and purple birthday hats. They are smiling broadly at the camera. In front of them, a black and white cat also wears a small gold birthday hat. The man holds a gold party blower. The background is a brightly lit, modern white-walled living room. (2) The woman, dressed in a white t-shirt and blue jeans, walks down a light-wood-floored hallway followed by the black and white cat. She leads the way to an open door while looking back at the pet. (3) The cat stands near a white pantry cabinet, looking up expectantly. The woman's hand enters the frame holding an orange and green bag of Greenies cat treats. The lighting is soft and natural from a nearby window. (4) A close-up shot shows the cat's face as the woman's fingers offer a single, brown, fish-shaped treat. The cat sniffs and then takes the treat into its mouth. (5) Five different flavored bags of Greenies are lined up on a white kitchen counter under bright studio-style lighting. The flavors include Oven-Roasted Chicken, Savory Salmon, Catnip, and Tempting Tuna. (6) An extreme close-up of a mobile screen displays a shopping interface showing Greenies products with over 56,000 reviews and a high rating. A red arrow points to the 'Purchased 4 times' text. (7) A single treat is held between two fingers with grey-painted nails, showcasing its textured, brush-like surface in sharp focus. (8) The cat is seen sitting on a brown rug in the kitchen, actively chewing a treat. Later, it plays with a silver and gold wand toy being waved by an off-screen hand. (9) The woman sits on the floor, petting the cat while holding a treat bag. The setting is a clean, modern kitchen with stainless steel appliances in the background. (10) The cat sleeps peacefully on a light grey armchair next to its birthday hat and party blower. The video ends with the couple holding the cat and smiling, while the woman points toward the bottom of the screen where text appears.

It uses the narrative of a 'senior' cat's 21st birthday to establish emotional connection and trust, subsequently detailing the health benefits, scientific backing, and high consumer ratings of the product to encourage viewers to purchase via a discount link.
